messages:
anya: Heads-up 1: overnight we got two escalations and a handful of smaller UX notes. Need to decide Sprint N+1 intake.
jordan: can you list the escalations?
anya: 1) memory leak on streaming sessions (customer X blocked). 2) embedding drift on recent model rollout for search (customer Y noticing ranking flips). plus ~5 UX polish items (labels, overflow).
mike: memory leak seems high risk  reproduction attached in the bug ticket. streaming sessions hit p99 mem growth over 30m.
renee: embedding drift looks tied to the model pin update last deploy. we can pin back to previous model quickly if needed. customer Y prefers rollback over retrain.
anya: proposal: 2-day hotfix for memory leak (blocker), rollback model pin for embeddings as short-term mitigation, and batch UX tweaks into a minor sprint patch. anyone object?
jordan: agree with that triage. What does "2-day" mean resource-wise? I want to avoid derailing the feature roadmap.
mike: I'll take the memory leak on Mon/Tue and loop @renee for validation. estimate 1.5 engineer-days + 0.5 testing.
renee: I'll own the rollback and customer comms for embeddings. rollback requires a canary test then prod flip; should be under 4 hours ops time. devops-bot: canary deployment reservation created (window: 2025-07-02T08:00Z - 2025-07-02T12:00Z) by @renee.
anya: good. Roadmap impact: we should free up ~3 engineer-days by deferring the 'smart rerank' scope item by one sprint. Jordan, can you confirm tradeoff with the feature owner?
jordan: pinged the feature owner in DM; they flagged that rerank has a dependency on infra work scheduled next sprint. deferring by 1 sprint seems acceptable. I'll update the roadmap.
mike: acceptance criteria for memory fix: sustained p99 memory drop >= 60% on repro harness + no regression on latency. Add a regression test to our e2e suite.
renee: for embeddings rollback: acceptance criteria = search rank restored on customer sample set + smoke test OK. I'll prepare rollback playbook.
anya: tagging for tickets: "triage/blocker", "customer/X", "area/streaming" and "triage/rollback", "customer/Y", "area/embeddings". please add notes for rollback windows.
jordan: I'll reprioritize backlog board and move smart-rerank to sprint N+2. leaving UX polish in N+1 as quick tasks.
mike: quick UX asks should be <3 dev-days total? I can pick 2 of them in the spare half-day after the memory fix.
renee: ops note: ensure we have a snapshot before rollback and an alert to abort if error rate spikes. devops-bot: snapshot created: snapshot-20250702-0800. monitoring play created: embedding-rollback-watch.
anya: schedule sync: 2025-07-02 17:00 PT to confirm hotfix outcome and decide whether to reallocate more cycles.
jordan: will run daily stand check-ins until resolved.
mike: starting on repro logging now, will post updates in the ticket.
renee: I'll draft the customer message and post to the partner channel after the rollback.
devops-bot: production last deploy: 2025-07-01T22:45Z (sha: d4c9a8).
